description.fr-FR: Les panégyriques et précis de panégyriques de Bossuet, prononcés de 1655 à 1668 : saint André, saint Jean, saint Thomas de Cantorbéry, saint François de Sales, saint Joseph, saint Benoît, saint François de Paule, saint Pierre, saint Paul, saint Bernard, saint François d’Assise, sainte Thérèse, sainte Catherine et d’autres. Édition Lachat (1863).
description.en-US: Bossuet’s panegyrics and outlines of panegyrics, preached between 1655 and 1668: Saint Andrew, Saint John, Saint Thomas of Canterbury, Saint Francis de Sales, Saint Joseph, Saint Benedict, Saint Francis of Paola, Saints Peter and Paul, Saint Bernard, Saint Francis of Assisi, Saint Teresa, Saint Catherine and others. Lachat edition (1863).
description.pt-BR: Os panegíricos e esboços de panegíricos de Bossuet, pregados entre 1655 e 1668: santo André, são João, são Tomás de Cantuária, são Francisco de Sales, são José, são Bento, são Francisco de Paula, são Pedro, são Paulo, são Bernardo, são Francisco de Assis, santa Teresa, santa Catarina e outros. Edição Lachat (1863).

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of the Lachat edition, volume012/001.htm to 023.htm. The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
